app.title: Open Space Simulator 2026
app.pitch: Your startup just raised 2 million. You have 18 months before everything blows up. Good luck.

menu.comingSoon: Your game is saved in this browser for now; cloud sync is coming soon.
menu.guestHint: No account, no leaderboard. Prod still goes down, though.

thoughts.tooYoungFramework: This framework is 3 years old. No.

roleDescriptions.SENIOR_BEARD: +50% quality, refuses frameworks younger than 5 years.
roleDescriptions.TEN_X: Very fast, but nobody understands their code: debt goes up.
roleDescriptions.INTERN: 5% chance per day to break prod.
roleDescriptions.RUSTACEAN: Wants to rewrite everything in Rust and converts colleagues.
roleDescriptions.DESIGNER: Blocks releases while the padding is wrong, +perceived quality at demos.
roleDescriptions.PRODUCT_OWNER: 4 meetings a day: -10% productivity for everyone, +hype.
roleDescriptions.AI_AGENT: Ultra fast, 30% chance to hallucinate a feature.
roleDescriptions.GHOST: Works remotely, invisible in the office, but tickets get closed.

treasury.name: Cash
treasury.help: Pays the salaries. At 0: bankruptcy, game over.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.help: The team's fuel. At 0: productivity divided by 3.

debt.name: Tech debt
debt.help: Goes up with every shortcut. Too high: bugs and unstable prod.

hype.name: Hype
hype.help: Appeal to investors. At 0: no more fundraising.

users.name: Users
users.help: Your user base. Grows with features, leaks when prod goes down.

morale.name: Morale
morale.help: A dev's motivation. At 0: resignation announced in a fake LinkedIn post.

kanban.dragHint: Drag a card between Backlog and To do, or use the arrows. Devs pick up "To do" tasks on their own.

hiring.intro: 3 candidates this sprint. Make an offer: too low and they refuse.
hiring.teamFull: Team is full for this phase ({{max}} max).

build.intro: Pick an item, then tap a tile to place it.

results.WRONG_STAGE: Not now: wrong step of the sprint.
results.TEAM_FULL: Team is full for this stage.
results.COOLDOWN: Investors want something new: wait a few sprints.
results.NO_HYPE: Zero hype: no investor will take your call.

dashboard.intro: Gauge history, one point per day.
dashboard.noData: No history yet: start a sprint.

credits.title: Credits
credits.kenney: 3D models: Kenney (kenney.nl), Furniture Kit and Blocky Characters packs, CC0 license.
credits.three: Rendering: Three.js. UI: React. Translations: i18next.
credits.missing: Assets missing from the packs, replaced by Three.js shapes or CSS:

steps.welcome: Welcome, founder. You have €2M and 18 months. This is your open space.
steps.gauges: At the top, your gauges. Hover or tap them to learn what they do.
steps.kanban: Open the Kanban and drag a task from Backlog to "To do".
steps.assign: Assign a task to a dev: they will start on it when the sprint begins.
steps.start: Start the sprint: the devs get to work.
steps.speed: Change the speed: pause, x1, x2 or x4.
steps.select: Click a dev (long press on mobile) to see their profile.
steps.build: Open build mode and buy a plant. They really help.

game.sceneLabel: 3D open space. Drag to move, wheel or pinch to zoom, Q and E to rotate, arrow keys to pan.
